answer: A rotating seed makes a fake identity pay per epoch instead of once. The words trellis, delta and grove only appear when the epoch opens, so an attacker cannot pre-write a corpus for a thousand cloned addresses and reuse it; every clone must answer live, inside the window, carrying those exact three. Cloning then costs a thousand submissions against one honest answer, and the quorum of four seals forces the swarm to earn attestations too, which the intake cap will not hand over fast enough to reach payout.
